summary: No aerial on Commons (the only overhead-ish photo is a 2010 FEMA flood shot of the exterior). Day: 2007 elevated sideline view at halftime; night: 2015 upper corner view of a full stadium.

files.note: Elevated east-side view across to the west stands and press box during a band show; field fills the lower 40 percent, roughly rows 700-1200. Predates the 2015 south end zone enclosure, but the west side shown is essentially unchanged.
